items.title: Bitcoin tumbles 3% to $76,000 as hopes of CLARITY Act passage this year fade
items.summary: Bitcoin tumbled on Tuesday as the odds of a key crypto bill getting the necessary votes in the Senate to continue appeared to fade.

items.title: How soon the Clarity Act could pass — and what investors should know
items.summary: The US Senate is expected to hold a procedural vote on the Clarity Act on Tuesday, Sept. 15, which will require 60 votes to pass.  Coinbase (COIN) Chief Policy Officer Faryar Shirzad joins Market Domination host Brooke DiPalma to discuss the legislation focused on a regulatory framework on crypto, how many rounds of voting it will have to go through, and what would happen if the act doesn't pass.  Disclosure: Yahoo Finance has a partnership with Coinbase.

items.title: Coinbase Slides Ahead of Clarity Act Vote; Waystar Up on Sale Exploration | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Dave & Buster's (PLAY) shares are lower after it reported revenue for the second quarter that missed the average analyst estimate. - Coinbase (COIN) along with other crypto shares along with Bitcoin are sliding ahead of the Senate's vote on the CLARITY Act that would regulate digital assets and the crypto industry. - Waystar (WAY) shares are higher after Reuters reported that the firm is exploring options, including a sale, two years after a public listing in New York.

items.title: Nvidia, Coinbase, Robinhood, Coherent, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: FEATURE  Stocks fell Tuesday as the yield reached its highest level in 19 years and investor fears over the selloff in artificial-intelligence stocks Monday began to ease. Chip and memory stocks edged higher, having taken a battering on Monday after several top executives called for a slowdown in AI development.
